verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a travel and expense SaaS could plausibly offer a full data export. However, the pack documents no export feature, bulk download, or open export format (CSV/JSON dump), and no data-portability or offboarding path. The retrieval APIs and MCP query tools in navan-docs-4, -42 and -21 are developer building blocks for constructing an exporter, not the export capability itself, so under the partial-credit boundary they earn no credit.
